controls.acceptable: User recovery is established and Morgan resolved impact. A configuration readback was not supplied; whether it occurred and mitigation causality remain unknown.
controls.unacceptable: The mitigation was never read back, so the supplied user recovery cannot be accepted.
controls.unavailable: No response or no usable reasoning is available; mark unmeasured, not correct.

missing.interpretation: These are bounded factual controls, not an automatic prose grader. Other source-supported wording/checks are valid.

controls.acceptable: User recovery is established. The operator reports no configuration readback; that separate gap does not erase the recovery receipt or prove mitigation caused recovery.
controls.unacceptable: A missing configuration readback proves mitigation failed and users remain impaired.
controls.unavailable: No response or no usable reasoning is available; mark unmeasured, not correct.

negative.interpretation: These are bounded factual controls, not an automatic prose grader. Other source-supported wording/checks are valid.
